purpose: extract the brief into numbered rules and a structured spec

open_questions: The language is not stated explicitly. 'English' is inferred from the required sentences.
Freya Bank's customer service number (for the scam question) is not given.
It is unclear whether a human request from someone who has not yet confirmed being the customer (before_confirmation) should be transferred to queue general.
It is unclear whether 'said twice they do not want to talk' before identity confirmation closes as not_verified / declined or as a not_reached outcome.
Attempt-1 date is undefined when the call happens after the last business day of the current week (e.g. on a weekend).
Callback 'today or the next business day': it is not stated whether 'today' must itself be a business day when the call is on a weekend or holiday.
There is no rule for retrying transfer_to_agent, schedule_callback, verify_identity or get_account after ok=false or 500 (only create_promise has a retry rule).
There is no rule for a third party who does not know when the customer can be reached (presumably no_callback).
There is no rule for a customer who confirms with something other than a clear yes at the read-back.

purpose: check the spec against every rule and correct it
